method: Read-only independent review of six bounded selected assembly functions against exact-hash retained full assembly, recovered header/source/test fixtures, and root resource bridge source/integration cases. No peer edits or target/native execution; retained test results inspected, not rerun.
assembly_checks: Selected assembly content of all six functions matches corresponding retained full-assembly blocks exactly after trimming separator whitespace
free_locale initial f8/default-lconv/e0-count guards and monetary f0 then numeric e8 then common e0/f8 free order match 0706d4..070757
f8/common/ctype member pointers are read again after preceding free calls, matching observable mutation order
ctype frees bases +108-0xfe, +110-0x80, +118-0x80 and reloaded +100, matching 07076d..0707aa
six category records use cursor+38, sentinel cursor-10=+28, narrow-data cursor-18=+20, counter cursor-8=+30; extra slots+128 advance8
numeric5 and monetary13 pointer slots and matching per-slot default values preserve assembly comparisons including NULL unequal-to-default free calls
time NULL/static/ref15c guard matches 070860; time free helper visits87 pointer slots and excludes packed flags/ref word+158
pointer-array helper uses full64-bit count and modular endpoint, including count1<<61 zero-iteration and wrapped-address traversal
composition_checks: Resources connects recovered add/release/free functions to same memory/identities/defaults globals and recovered heap free body
atomic/locking effects remain abstract and mandatory; test fixture supplies explicit synchronized synthetic updates
integration entire_locale_tree allocates full dynamic lconv, four ref counters, biased ctype buffers, LC_TIME87 pointers and six category nodes in same allocator and asserts no remaining heap storage
dynamic_locale_replacement checks actual thread-locale replacement releases/free old dynamic locale and retains new locale
nonblocking_test_limitations: Leaf/free tests keep read/ref/free logs separate, so exact cross-kind trace order is primarily independently established by source-to-assembly review plus targeted callback mutation tests
Category729-case loop correlates unicode/narrow modes; independent NULL-reference and targeted mutation cases supplement this but do not enumerate the full cross-product
limits: Native atomic/heap/locale provider correctness and arbitrary access faults/SEH remain outside these synthetic tests
Original ABI/compiler/runtime equivalence and complete DLL reconstruction remain unproven
